Guidelines for the installation of Manage Engine Agent on WINDOWS Desktop PCs

1.       Login in the Desktop PC as Administrator

2.       Copy and Paste the below mentioned URL in a browser and hit Enter Key. https://drive.google.com/file/d/1bRx8xd3EK8LNS3xrd2LMH9q1enATdIQi/view?usp=sharing

3.       A Google Drive page will show up .

4.       Click on Download Button placed at top right corner.


5.       Go to Downloads folder and Right Click on the zip file ManageEngineAgentInstallationFiles.zip and extract the files to the Desktop.

6.      

Double click on the newly created Folder ManageEngineAgentInstallationFiles

7.       Open the sub folder WindowsAgent


8.      

Right click on the file LocalOffice_Agent and select the option Run as administrator

 

9.      

In confirmation message, click on Yes button

 

10.  

A ManageEngineUEMS Agent will show up. Enter the given code in the text box and click on OK button.

 

11.  

Then click Next> button

12.  

Again click on Next> button

 

13.   After few minutes, following confirmation message will be shown.


14.   Check for the icon at the right corner of the task bar.

 

 

Done !

The agent has been successfully installed in the PC.
